answer: Require each identity to maintain a stake-bonded thread of verifiable work: a public, time-stamped chain of signed contributions that mirrors its claimed history, so reputation cannot be faked overnight. Each identity locks a refundable deposit, slashed if two identities share the same work thread or key material, and renews the thread at each dawn of a new epoch with a fresh identity-bound challenge. A thousand fakes then cost a thousand deposits plus a thousand distinct histories; an honest agent pays only one of each.
